# Mediline Biotex Pvt. Ltd.

> Bangalore-based pharmaceutical supply chain company: carrying & forwarding agent (CFA), carrying & selling agent (CSA), super distributor and distributor for corporate hospitals. ISO 9001:2015 and WHO Good Distribution Practice (WHO-GDP) certified, with validated cold chain storage. Tagline: "Life Ahead".

## Key facts

- Legal name: Mediline Biotex Pvt. Ltd. Founded in Bangalore in 2020.
- What it does: holds and forwards stock for pharmaceutical principals (CFA / CSA), super distribution, and supplies critical care, oncology and life-saving medicines to corporate hospitals, pharmacies and institutions. Direct-to-patient supply of anti-cancer and speciality medicines against a verified prescription, coordinated with the treating hospital.
- Scale: 23 pharmaceutical principals carried; 5 CFA & CSA mandates; 200+ hospitals and pharmacies supplied; 30+ staff across operations, commercial and finance.
- Financial year 2025–26: ₹28.72 crore own sales, plus ₹44.99 crore of CFA operations handled on behalf of principals (the principals' sales, not Mediline's turnover).
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015 (verifiable at qrocert.org) and WHO-GDP (verifiable at ukascert.co.uk).
- Storage bands: cold room 2–8°C (vaccines, biologics, insulins); cool room 15–25°C (speciality orals); ambient below 30°C (general formulations).
- Coverage: CFA mandates cover Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and all-India central warehousing depending on the principal; deliveries reach metro and non-metro cities across India through logistics partners.
- Branches: 3 — two in Bangalore (head office on Sarjapur Main Road; Hosa Road) and one in Mangalore.
- During COVID-19 it was among the appointed distributors of Remdesivir in Karnataka and worked with the state government on COVID medicine distribution.

## Therapy areas (9)

Oncology; Critical care; Transplant; Nephrology; Anti-diabetic; Dermatology; General medicine; Medical devices & diagnostics; Sanitisation.

## Principals

- Carrying & forwarding (CFA): Natco Pharma, Converge Biotech, Sayre Therapeutics, Aclaris Therapeutics, Cytosorbents India.
- Super distribution: Surishi Pharmaceuticals, Strassenburg Pharmaceuticals, RA-Vish Wellness.
- Supply to corporate hospitals: Zydus Lifesciences, Lupin Limited, Macleods Pharmaceuticals, Mylan Pharmaceuticals, RA-Vish Wellness, Corona Remedies, Sayre Therapeutics, Natco Pharma, Tasmid India, Kiosence Healthcare, Elbrit Lifesciences, Celon Labs, Cadila Pharmaceuticals, Vasu Organics, Aclaris Therapeutics, Stanex Drugs & Chemicals, Graviti Pharmaceuticals, Iberia Skinbrands, Surishi Pharmaceuticals, Converge Biotech, Healthium Medtech.

## Leadership

- Nisha — Founder & Managing Director. Leads carrying & forwarding operations, CSA operations and corporate hospital supplies; the organisation's decision maker.
- Pramod Kumar — Director. 35+ years in pharmaceutical supply chain; formerly General Manager and Head of Distribution & Hospitals at Biocon (India and SAARC); twice recipient of Biocon's Chairman's Award (FY 2010–11 and FY 2017–18).
- Function heads: Vishal Vinayak (Operations & warehouse), Rajesh V (Commercial — hospital & CFA business), Gopal Samanta (Financial accounts).
